_why: Read by railway/merge_train.py. Every number here is DERIVED from what this repo actually runs, never guessed. See railway/merge_train.py for what each key means and docs/TECHLOG.md for the measurement.
_min_checks: MEASURED 2026-09-16 over the 30 most recently merged pull requests: every one carried exactly 7 check runs on its head SHA (four railway-tests legs, version, two compare). The floor is 5 rather than 7 so a path-filtered absence cannot wedge the queue, and it is nowhere near 1: the state this catches is 'CI has not started', which reads 0 to 2.
_plugin: A plugin pull request is refused while a deploy has run inside the window. Two plugin deploys inside an hour is how the shared host has been taken down; the last deploy time is READ from the Actions API, never guessed.
_post_merge: The train merges with the default Actions token, and a push made with that token starts no on-push workflow. After every run the train reconciles main: it dispatches deploy_workflow when main's plugin tree differs from the last green deploy and no deploy ran inside the window, and it dispatches each workflow below when main's head carries no run of it. Each must declare workflow_dispatch.
_mechanical: The ONLY conflicts the train may resolve. docs/TECHLOG.md is append-only, so both entries are kept. Nothing here is program logic, and ALT_VERSION is deliberately absent: it lives inside a PHP source file, and a version collision is already owned by version-collision.yml and fixed with a fresh bump, by a person.
_forbidden: Refused BY NAME, so widening the allowlist can never reach them. This is railway/self_heal.py FORBIDDEN plus the reference and correction material; railway/tests/test_merge_train_forbidden_parity.py fails if self_heal grows an entry this list does not have.
_human_only: A check whose name contains any of these is NEVER healed, in any shape, including a cancel. A wrong number already published needs a person.
